svg.title: Editor bone posing, IK handles, onion skinning and curve view (proposal)
svg.desc: The editor 3D view with a skinned character at 0.12 s of the jump: bones drawn over the mesh, the left upper leg selected with a local rotate gizmo, foot IK targets pinned, a knee pole handle, onion-skin ghosts of the previous and next keys, and a viewport toolbar with bones, IK, pin feet and onion toggles. Below, the Animation panel in curve view shows the selected bone's flex, abduct and twist curves in degrees with keys.
svg.text: Viewport toggles (icons with tooltips): bones, IK handles, pin feet,
onion skin; the onion settings sit under them.
Bones drawn over the mesh; the picked bone gets a rotate gizmo in its
local space. K keys it (Rotation3DTrack, created when missing).
IK targets for feet and hands (diamonds; pinned shows a pin) and
pole handles; dragging writes bone rotations through TwoBoneIk.
Onion skin: ghosts of earlier (blue) and later (green) poses.
The bone's anatomical angles (humanoid bones) with key buttons;
non-humanoid bones show local Euler angles.
Curve view of the selected rotation track: flex, abduct, twist in
degrees; drag keys in time and value, set ease per key.
The panel (G1a) switches between key view and curve view.
Proposal (G1d). Edits go into the scene tab's undo history as SetTrackKeysAction; stored keys stay ordinary quaternion keys.
